scripts.dev: concurrently -n reporter,admin,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace=@speak-up/reporter" "npm run dev --workspace=@speak-up/admin" "npm run dev --workspace=@speak-up/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@speak-up/shared && npm run build --workspace=@speak-up/api && npm run build --workspace=@speak-up/reporter && npm run build --workspace=@speak-up/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@speak-up/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
